$comment: Manual corrections, checked against official conference websites and merged after each automatic update. Keys are venue names. Venue fields (fullName, homepage, ...) replace the source values. `editions` is keyed by year and merged into that edition; an edition `cycles` list replaces the whole list (deadlineTime + timezone as stated in the official CFP). A year missing from the sources adds that edition. `homepage` is the series site, used to link estimated editions.
